name: Balance

name: Hormones in general
example: Hormones are super important. As they say, "hormones affect everything and everything affects your hormones", and it's so true: how you feel, perceive, act and think, your confidence, your mental and physical well-being.

name: Willpower
example: The biggest benefit of cold showers: you literally increase your willpower, your strength against resistance in every area of life.
